newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Group Five to cut back property operations.
newsitem.headline: Group Five to cut back property operations.

text.p: South African building and construction firm Group Five Ltd said on Thursday it would scale down its property development operations as a result of depressed market conditions.
Chief executive officer Mike Lomas said in a statement that market volatility, high interest rates and heavy capital requirements had contributed to the decision to cut back on its property division.

"It goes without saying that we will continue to meet our obligations in respect of existing contracts and commitments," he said, adding that various strategic businesses in the division will be reallocated within the group.
"Wherever possible, employees affected by these changes will be redeployed elsewhere in the group."
Lomas said that Group Five had for many years been a leader in the residential development market.
Group Five in February reported a rise in year earnings per share to 36.0 cents versus 31.1 cents previously. The dividend was lifted to 9.0 cents from 7.0 cents.
The firm said then that all its divisions, bar building and property development, had contributed to profit growth.
